tokens.text: Visit badges by the building tooltip
Left of a building's tooltip: visited or available, and how often it can be visited (once, per hero, per player, weekly or daily).
A line in the building's tooltip: visited or available and the visit rule in words.
The game's line repeats the visit badge, it can be hidden.
How the outline of objects not visited yet stands out. The outline color is chosen in the game's settings, Visibility.
Guards in the tooltip of a guarded building
Who guards a unit dwelling or another guarded place and how dangerous the battle is, shown as in a squad's tooltip, without walking up to it.
